method: Independent recount of raw test events, excluding hidden lifecycle cases and separating skipped=true from successful execution. Case identity=(repository-relative suite path, full test name, registration ordinal); ordinal is 1 except the four explicitly source-verified parameterized policy registrations. historical_editor_check.qualification: Historical read-only formatter failure on the incoming sync-dialog test; later published main supplies its formatted version. This receipt is preserved and not represented as a passing format gate.

final_render.comparison: Exact zero-tolerance RGBA assertions in the executed test; independently recounted PNG and normalized layout SHA-256 values. Layout fingerprints normalize only transient source-model identity hashes.

parameterized_identity_proofs.display_title: ordinary mutation policy applies to proofing controls: Instance of 'OfficeMacroPolicy'
parameterized_identity_proofs.explanation: Four distinct parameterized registrations share their default object-string display title. Each raw ID completes once in one suite. Registration ordinal distinguishes these source-verified cases; no repeated cohort is added.

historical_composed_editor.qualification: Historical 510+8 only. Original perf stream contains a disk-full loader error; complete file results were composed with the subsequent successful schedule run. Six later shared engine-source changes require the new single-process final16 run. Do not add these repeated passes to final totals.

initial_incoming_118.qualification: Historical successful intake, not added to final-current totals. Subsequent core/Mail UI/Studio and shared Word source changes invalidate a blanket final-source claim. Late Mail/final engine/final editor gates qualify their explicitly selected current scopes; they do not imply all original118 were repeated.

converter.scope: Synthetic Add Note callbacks followed by existing Zotero transfer export/import handshake and an actual independent LibreOffice file converter. No live Zotero CSL session or Word/LibreOffice/OpenOffice plugin acceptance.

limitations: No live Zotero session or Word/LibreOffice/OpenOffice plugin acceptance is claimed by synthetic callback/controller tests or headless converter checks.
The documented DOCX-to-ODT-to-DOCX list-numbering failure remains a failed route and is not included as a passing test.
